The two user-global roots share one group, so the shared-root file collapses behind a matching harness-home file; sibling project candidates collapse the same way, while a distinct real copy that has drifted from `AGENTS.md` loads in full alongside it. A duplicate of budget-retained content stays reconciled: when the retained candidate changes or disappears, the duplicate becomes visible again. Unchanged hidden duplicates, including files removed from visible state as duplicates, use cached metadata instead of content reads.
